prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in the basic modules for Practical Informatics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have basic knowledge and skills in the area of Digital Transformation
know the theoretical basics of Digital Transformation as well as selected applications
are able to apply working methods from business informatics
are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion

syllabus_topics: Concept understanding, differentiation from information management, localization of phenomena and developments
IT-induced changes in management, strategy and organization
Impact of transformation on companies and industries

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program. To acquire ECTS points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments.
